title: TMF Annual Change, 1990 to 2025
description: JRC Tropical Moist Forests (TMF) v1.2025: the TMF status of every 30 m cell in each year from 1990 to 2025 (6 classes), one COG per tile and year. Produced by the European Commission Joint Research Centre; mirrored by Epoch as north-up ZSTD COGs with pixel values unchanged. 86 tiles of about 10 by 10 degrees in EPSG:4326 at 0.00026949 degrees (about 30 m). One item per tile and year (36 years), plus a virtual icechunk store over all six products. See [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for tested access recipes.

providers.name: Epoch
providers.description: Re-encoded the JRC tiles as north-up ZSTD COGs, pixel values unchanged, and hosts them on Source Cooperative.

sci:publications.citation: Vancutsem, C., Achard, F., Pekel, J.-F., et al. (2021). Long-term (1990-2019) monitoring of forest cover changes in the humid tropics. Science Advances.

bands.name: AnnualChange
bands.description: TMF status in one year, classes 1 to 6, identical legend for every year. Value 0 is not in the JRC legend; the files declare no NoData value.
